europe_now.title: UK Court Convicts Iranian Men for Spying on Journalists
europe_now.summary: A UK court has convicted two Iranian men for conducting surveillance operations targeting journalists. The case highlights ongoing concerns regarding transnational security threats within European borders.

sources.headline: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists

europe_now.title: Zelenskyy Demands Europe Join Ukraine Talks
europe_now.summary: Ukrainian leadership has publicly insisted that European nations must be included as regular participants in upcoming diplomatic negotiations regarding the conflict. The demand comes amid ongoing discussions involving international envoys and regional security frameworks.

sources.headline: Zelenskyy demands Europe become ‘regular part’ of Ukraine talks

top_stories.title: UK Espionage Conviction
top_stories.summary: A British court has successfully convicted two individuals of spying on journalists. The ruling highlights ongoing foreign intelligence threats operating within the United Kingdom.

sources.headline: UK court convicts 2 Iranian men of spying on journalists

top_stories.title: Ukraine Diplomatic Representation
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian officials have formally requested that European states maintain a permanent seat at upcoming peace negotiations. The diplomatic push follows high-level international meetings involving foreign envoys.
